acquisition_method.evidence: The mass spectrometer was operated in data-dependent acquisition mode.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: followed by CAA addition and incubation in dark for 30 minutes.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Lys-C protease was added at enzyme:substrate ratio of 1:75 and incubated for 4 hours.
Finally, Trypsin was added at enzyme:substrate ratio of 1:75 and incubated overnight.

fragmentation_method.evidence: subjected to HCD fragmentation at a normalized collision energy of 27%.

mass_analyzer.evidence: All samples were analyzed by the CECAD proteomics facility on a Q Exactive Plus Orbitrap mass spectrometer
